Munh se na kabhi uf kahte hain,
Sankat ka charan na gahte hain,
Jo aa parta sab sahte hain,
Udyog-nirat nit rahte hain.
Shulon ka mul nasate hain,
Barh khud vipatti par chhate hain..
Para Commandos make all possible. Fit body, robust mind, Para Commandos are elite fighters & force multiplier. Their every knock are a thunder.
